text:
Carla: Quick heads-up — planning a staggered rollout for routing policy v2 tonight. deploy-bot shows a default time but I'd like to land at 23:00 PT or later. Need approvals and one extra holdpoint at 10% with telemetry gates. Anyone seeing conflicts with infra window?

Ben: infra window currently scheduled 22:30-23:30 PT for host kernel patch. If we run at 23:00 we'll collide. Can we move to ~01:00 PT or shift the infra window? @carla?

Alice: approval queue shows 2 pending from product. We can fast-track but keep the manual hold at 10%. Also propose a gate that fails on a relative 5% increase in 5xxs over 5m.

Carla: agreed. Proposed rollout config — please eyeball and flag anything risky:```yaml
release: routing-v2
strategy: phased
steps:
  - traffic: 1%
    hold: 300s
  - traffic: 10%
    hold: 600s
    telemetry_gates:
      - metric: 5xx_rate
        threshold: 0.05
        window: 300s
  - traffic: 50%
    hold: 900s
  - traffic: 100%
```

Dan: quick question — does this policy change affect session affinity/sticky cookies? Need to ensure logged-in flows keep affinity 100% or we risk UX issues.

Emma: feature-flag gating is ready. We can scope the early waves to non-enterprise tenants. Recommend excluding enterprise and regulated orgs from first 2 waves.

Frank: on the console side, can we add a per-tenant series to the rollout chart and surface guard hits as a top-level alert? Ops wants instant visibility to decide rollback.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout for routing-v2 at 2026-03-20 23:00 PT by Carla. Waiting for approvals: product, security. To approve: `/deploy approve 1768901234`

Carla: tagging @ops-oncall for final thumbs-up. Ops, can you validate fallback route, quota constraints, and confirm no customer-facing quotas will be tripped at 50% traffic?

ops-oncall: I'll run the smoke script and verify fallback before T-30m. If kernel patch blocks us I can requeue deploy-bot to 01:15 PT. Will post pass/fail + logs here.

Alice: product approvals bumped to 2/2. Security flagged one minor audit-log schema change, now addressed.

Ben: thanks — infra can move the host patch to 00:30 PT so we avoid overlap. I'd prefer deploy at 01:15 PT to be safe.

Carla: final checklist: 1) deploy-bot scheduled 01:15 PT; 2) holdpoints 1% / 10% / 50%; 3) telemetry gates as above; 4) enterprise excluded from early waves; 5) console alerting enabled. If no objections I'll kick it off after ops sign-off.

ops-oncall: smoke OK. fallback route verified. logs: `smoke-routing-check OK`, `fallback-switch OK`. Handing off to deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: Approved and scheduled: routing-v2 -> 01:15 PT. Will notify #incidents if any telemetry gate fires. :rocket:
